title: Utilizing surface modified poultry feathers for senary multi-metal water purification: kinetic and thermodynamic behavior of heavy metal-laden biosorbent
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25450-25472
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02131F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Faisal Irfan, Tariq Siddique, Aman Ullah
This study optimized poultry feathers to remove six trace metals (Cr, As, V, Co, Ni, Cd) from water and evaluated the biosorbent's thermal and bioenergy potential.
